changelog: Fixes Factory Reset failing with PermissionError when restoring ~/.config/labwc/autostart and environment, on devices where those files are read-only. Also broadens error handling in both the update and factory-reset flows to catch any exception (not just the deliberate internal UpdateError type), so an unexpected failure always writes a "failed" status instead of leaving the control page stuck showing stale in-progress text forever. Also includes all v0.15.2 changes (control page auto-reload after a factory-reset reboot) and v0.15.1 changes (firmware-update status-reporting race fix).
